SELECT home_store_id, is_current, count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, min(join_date) minjoin, max(join_date) maxjoin, count(DISTINCT member_key) keys
FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) OR home_store_id IS NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, count(DISTINCT member_key) keys, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) cur_members, min(join_date), max(join_date), sum(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_ended FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) members, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) distinct_ids, sum(CASE WHEN m.join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_join, sum(CASE WHEN m.tier IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_tier, sum(CASE WHEN m.join_date > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_join, min(m.member_id) minid, max(m.member_id) maxid, count(DISTINCT m.tier) tiers
FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_key=u.member_key)) stg_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates u WHERE u.is_current AND u.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)) stg_current_tampere,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.is_current AND m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member x ON x.member_key=f.member_key WHERE x.member_id=m.member_id AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-08')) active12m,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.member_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member x ON x.member_key=f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.city='Tampere' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-08') shoppers_tampere_stores_12m

calls.statement:
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS tampere_loyalty_members
FROM dim_member AS m
JOIN dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
